c.responsibility: Design a customizable analytics dashboard with 12 charts, date filters and auto-refresh. Metric computation is server-owned. Widgets have different latency and freshness requirements; one failing chart must not block the others.
c.contract: props: identity, locale and initial data; events: selection, change, retry; local contract below
c.rendering: 12 widgets, each at most 1,000 displayed points; 4 concurrent queries; hidden-tab refresh suspended.
c.accessibility: Each chart has a title, units, textual summary and accessible table/download alternative; keyboard controls for filters and layout, distinguish data series beyond color.

n.no: Coordinates this feature. Coordinate filter changes with a generation key but give each widget an independent query/error boundary. Limit parallel requests, pause refresh in hidden tabs and request server aggregation/downsampling for the visible chart resolution. Alternative: A batched endpoint reduces requests but can couple slow widgets. Independent queries improve isolation; server snapshot tokens are needed if exact cross-widget consistency matters.
